messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: lavaan 0.5-16 has been released
parts:
Hi all,

lavaan 0.5-16 has been released on CRAN. Here is a list with new
features/changes:

- parameterization="theta" is now available for categorical data

- initial support for marginal maximum likelihood (estimator = "MML")

- new function lavTestLRT() to compare nested models using LRT; the
anova() function is now just a wrapper around this function

- in both the anova() and lavTestLRT() function, SB.classic=TRUE is the
default; to get the old behaviour, use SB.classic=FALSE

- new function lavTestWald() allows for arbitrary Wald tests

- new function lavCor() to compute polychoric/tetrachoric/...
correlations directly from the data

- fitMeasures() gains a new baseline.model argument to allow for
user-defined baseline models

- new group.w.free argument allows the group weights to be treated as
free parameters in a multiple group analysis

- new functions lavTablesFitCf(), lavTablesFitCm(), lavTablesFitCp()
provide three measures of fit for the PML method (contributed by Mariska
Barendse)

- SRMR is now identical to the Mplus value if information = "observed";
the WRMR is added to the output if mimic = "Mplus"

- allow for zero iterations using control=list(optim.method="none") argument

The plan is to have a final version of the 0.5 series (0.5-17) around
eastern. Then, development of the 0.6 series (with multilevel SEM) can
finally begin.

Yves.

--
Yves Rosseel -- http://www.da.ugent.be
Department of Data Analysis, Ghent University
http://lavaan.org
